## How was it tested?

<!-- Commands you ran, devices/emulators and OS versions used, screenshots or recordings for UI changes. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused, and the PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, ...).
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass locally.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated for changed behaviour.
- [ ] No hard-coded user-facing strings; any new keys exist in **both** `locales/en.json` and `locales/tr.json`.
- [ ] If this touches the timer, background handling or notifications, I tested on **both iOS and Android** (details above).
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files or personal data are included.
- [ ] Any new image, sound or font has a compatible licence and is listed in `ASSETS.md`.
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` (under *Unreleased*) are updated if behaviour changed.
